cities: One store, in El Monte · independent shops, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned: Claim, ownership unproven: about page says 'every stage of our manufacturing takes place in-house at our workshop' (El Monte CA: retail, shipping, cutting, screen printing, factory space). Apparel News Nov 2020 (press): 13,000 sq ft compound, 13 staff, 6 sewers, 1920s-60s machines; owned vs leased not stated anywhere.
craft_evidence.makers: Brand itself (Railcar workshop, El Monte CA) on product pages; boots by Whites Boots, Spokane WA (collab, 'their 150 year old plant').
craft_evidence.mills: Yes, in product titles/pages: Kurabo (Japan), Cone Mills (Hickory), Candiani, Unshin (sashiko). Other denim called 'Japanese' with no mill. Chambray is 'deadstock', mill not named.
craft_evidence.madein: 8 of 10 product pages read state El Monte/California/USA workshop (Kurabo jeans, wax jacket, Type 1, chore coat, Eliminator, chambray, Flight Trouser, boots); graphic tee says only 'Printed in California'; Helmet crewneck says screen printed in-house, no country. Collection pages do not state country.
craft_evidence.heritage: Dated and placed: founded 2010 by Steven Dang from his home; Arcadia 1,000 sq ft unit 2011; Monrovia 4,000 sq ft store/warehouse with full in-house production 2014; El Monte HQ 2020 (about page).
craft_evidence.process: Partly: prewash before cutting, in-house shrink tests (cold wash hang dry), sanforized, flat-felled seams, chain-stitch hemming, washer-burr rivets, hand-attached details; no machine or loom documentation on brand pages (vintage machines are press).
craft_evidence.reasoning: Brand states all manufacturing is in-house at its El Monte workshop and product pages repeat it with USA hardware and named Japanese/American/Italian denim mills, so maker and brand are close to one. Held at 4 not 5 because ownership of the facility is not stated by the brand, and cloth is sourced globally (mills named on some, not all, pages), footwear is made by Whites. Sebastian may rule 5 if in-house workshop counts as owned.

ownership.owner: Founder-run by Steven Dang (about page); legal ownership not stated
